title: Calendar
description: One calendar in a workspace (calendar/calendars/<id>.json): who owns it, who is on it, and who may see it. Events name it by id. A workspace is initiated with the default calendar, default, named Venture (Torian, 2026-10-30; packages/naive/src/engine/calendar.mjs).

id.description: The calendar's id, the file's name without .json

owner.description: The person who owns it, by id (a founder id, or founder)

members.description: People on the calendar, by id

visibility.description: private: the owner only; members: those listed; workspace: everyone in the workspace
